sourceTitle: ICYMI: Transfer your history from other AI apps into Gemini.
originalTitle: ICYMI: Transfer your history from other AI apps into Gemini.

blocks.text: Switch to Gemini without starting from scratch. Here’s how to bring your context, preferences, and chat history from a different AI assistant into Gemini.
blocks.zh: 切换到Gemini而不从零开始.以下是如何介绍你的背景,首选,然后从一个不同的AI助手 聊天到Gemini
blocks.en: Switch to Gemini without starting from scratch. Here’s how to bring your context, preferences, and chat history from a different AI assistant into Gemini.

blocks.text: Open your Gemini import settings and copy our prompt.
blocks.zh: 打开您的双子宫导入设置并复制我们的提示 。
blocks.en: Open your Gemini import settings and copy our prompt.

blocks.text: Paste it into your previous AI tool to generate a summary of your preferences.
blocks.zh: 粘贴到您先前的 AI 工具, 生成您的喜好摘要 。
blocks.en: Paste it into your previous AI tool to generate a summary of your preferences.

blocks.text: Export a ZIP file of your chat history from your previous provider's account settings.
blocks.zh: 从上一个提供者的账户设置中导出您聊天历史的 ZIP 文件 。
blocks.en: Export a ZIP file of your chat history from your previous provider's account settings.

blocks.text: Upload the ZIP archive in Gemini settings to pick up conversations right where you left off.
blocks.zh: 在Gemini设置中上传 ZIP 存档, 以获取您离开的地方的对话 。
blocks.en: Upload the ZIP archive in Gemini settings to pick up conversations right where you left off.
